data.title: 丛雨 · 神刀微鸣的灵体傲娇
data.action: 飘浮盘坐在半空中，双手抱胸神气活现，娇小脚尖轻点虚空，金瞳微嗔，发带随灵力飘摇，脸颊鼓起可爱的弧度。
data.location: 丛雨神社神圣内殿，古老神刀静静供奉在紫檀木刀架上，御币微颤
data.lighting: 窗外如霜的皎洁月色，配合神刀散发的淡淡金白灵力辉光，将整座木殿笼罩在神话氛围中
data.mood: 灵动可爱、童颜神明的傲娇与跨越数百年的亲昵依恋
data.description: 丛雨神社神圣内殿，古老神刀静静供奉在紫檀木刀架上，御币微颤。飘浮盘坐在半空中，双手抱胸神气活现，娇小脚尖轻点虚空，金瞳微嗔，发带随灵力飘摇，脸颊鼓起可爱的弧度。 她微微抬眸轻语——“呼哈哈！即便吾是寄宿在神剑里的灵体，也是有女孩子的矜持的！不过……看在汝是主人的份上，特许汝再看一眼吧！”
data.promptProse: Floating effortlessly cross-legged mid-air inside her silent shrine sanctuary at night, Murasame folds her arms with a proud, cute pout in a crimson gold-embroidered short spirit haori with sheer sleeves over a white linen sarashi bodice. Pale moonlight streams past paper gohei onto the lacquered katana stand resting below.
data.animaCaption: Floating cross-legged mid-air inside the quiet wooden shrine in a crimson gold-crested short haori and white sarashi wrap, she folds her arms with puffed cheeks and a proud, playful pout. Pale moonlight and soft spirit glow shimmer above her katana stand.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a crimson gold-embroidered short spirit haori with sheer wide sleeves and red tassel cords over a snug white linen sarashi bodice.
